rules.statement: A plea of prescription should be carefully scrutinized and upheld only upon the clearest evidence of denial of the right of the de jure incumbent to exercise his office.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is imperative that a plea of prescription should be carefully scrutinized and that such a plea should be upheld only upon the clearest evidence of the denial of the right of the de jure incumbent to exercise, his office."

meta.parties: Panditha Watugedera Amaraseeha Thero v. Tittagalle Sasanatilake Thero
